notes.title: March 17 - Version 1.03 Update
notes.content: 500+ unique decorative items across various themes

notes.title: 3/3 Update
notes.content: Brand new lofi album with 10 new tracks.

notes.title: 2/22 Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed texture duplication issue when creating fish.

notes.title: Version 1.02 Major Update
notes.content:
70 types of ambient white noise
40+ ground textures
10+ wall textures
20+ dust and weather effects
900+ new decorative objects, including natural landscapes, steampunk themes, and fantasy worlds
20 types of gemstones that drop when feeding fish
Three selectable desktop aquarium sizes
Clock and Pomodoro timer can now be freely dragged

notes.title: 📢 02/16 Update Announcement 📢
notes.content:
✨ New Content: A brand new album featuring 10 LoFi tracks! 🎶🌊

🐠 Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed an issue where aquarium level upgrades could revert.
2. Fixed a UI glitch caused by feeding food.

notes.title: 2/13 Hotfix
notes.content:
1. Fixed an issue where the main light → depth of field toggle was incorrect, causing the sky rotation and dust slider to be locked.

2. Fixed a bug where feeding food caused hotkeys to become unresponsive.

notes.title: 2/13 Update
notes.content: Fixed a bug where underwater objects would disappear when placed.

notes.title: 2/12 Update
notes.content:
You can now click on fish to lay eggs (money), and they will also lay eggs automatically after 60 seconds.
Fixed an issue with the music album icon in the shop.
Clicking on UI panels no longer affects objects behind them.

notes.title: 2/11 Operation Optimization Update
notes.content:
1. UI Interface Optimization
2. Added Shortcut Key [Del] for Deleting Objects
3. Merged Shop Music Albums into the Music Playback Panel

notes.title: 2/11 Hotfix 2
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug where the text in the exit confirmation prompt (Esc) was affected after pressing the "Clear Aquarium" button.

2.Fixed an issue where fish emojis would disappear after loading a save file.

3.Fixed a bug where clicking on a fish sometimes wouldn't trigger an emoji.

4.Fixed an issue where placed Valentine's Day items could not be clicked after loading a save file.

5.Fixed a bug where overlapping objects prevented the mouse from accurately selecting the first object it touched.

notes.title: February 11 Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the game would get stuck on the loading screen after placing the Disco Ball.
Fixed a bug where objects could not be stacked correctly.

notes.title: 2/10 hotFix
notes.content:
1. Fixed an issue where customers would no longer appear after loading a save.
2. Fixed an issue where the aquarium button had no fish icon after loading a save.
3. Fixed an issue where the upgrade aquarium button could not be clicked.

Found more bugs? Please report them at https://discord.gg/kKgU2xaj
